# Scene state ownership

The retained `Scene.Application()` owns the authoritative component state through
its Bendvy world. Future simulation chunks must be storage owned by that world,
with exclusive access transferred to a numerical task and returned afterward.
They cannot be an independently writable mirror of ECS components.

This contract completes the E2 ownership decision. Entangle has no simulation
chunk implementation or chunk transfer API yet. R0 must establish which storage
operations the pinned Bend toolchain and Bendvy can support.

## Authoritative state and observations

For each live entity and component, one storage owner determines the next
authoritative value. Several systems can update that storage in schedule order.
A single owner does not mean that only one system may ever write a component.

| Representation | Authority |
| --- | --- |
| `Scene.Application()` and its `D.World()` | Retain component storage, allocator, deferred commands, and schedule state. |
| Registered `GeneralWriter` and its execution scope `H` | Authorize an update of the current component in that world. The operation consumes and returns the scope. |
| `C.Transform`, query row views, and `Observe.Snapshot` | Copyable values. They carry no scope or writer and cannot publish themselves. |
| `Draw.DrawList` | Detached rendering input. It has neither entity handles nor a component writer. |
| Future owned simulation chunks | A partition of authoritative storage while tasks hold it. Ordinary ECS access to that partition must be unavailable until ownership returns. |
| Future halos, neighbor snapshots, and render projections | Derived read inputs with a defined observation phase. They do not authorize component replacement. |

`World`, the retained application state, and the schedule wrapper have kind
`Type`. Bend's affine checker prevents reusing the same owner. Component records
have kind `Data`, so copying a transform remains legal and useful.

Affinity alone does not establish this contract. Two separately allocated affine
arrays can contain independently evolving copies of the same components. A
component handle also identifies an entity without granting access to its storage.

## Current write path

[`scene-schema.bend`](../src/scene-schema.bend) registers ordinary `Transform` and
`MeshRef` columns. Its payload-to-view projections copy values for observation.
They do not transfer component storage to the reader.

[`scene.bend`](../src/scene.bend) retains the world inside `Scene.Application()`.
`Scene.run` consumes that application and returns its successor with a schedule
report. Bootstrap publishes initial components before the movement system runs.

[`scene-motion.bend`](../src/scene-motion.bend) requests a `WriteRows` capability
for transforms on entities with `MeshRef`. `move_rows` uses the selected handle
and discards the row's copied transform. `GeneralWriter.modify` supplies the
current stored transform to `translate`, which calls `Step.step` and returns the
replacement. Each call returns the scope used by the next row.

Calling `Step.step` on a snapshot calculates a detached value. It does not update
the scene. Production movement has no snapshot-to-world writeback operation.
Later systems must also update through the owner instead of installing values
computed from an earlier observation without an explicit conflict policy.

Numerical writes are immediate. A refused query returns the incoming scope.
A refused write stops movement and retains earlier accepted writes. Structural
commands publish at the schedule's apply boundaries. Ownership transfer must not
silently turn these operations into an atomic batch or add rollback. See the
[headless reference](headless-reference.md) and
[schedule visibility contract](schedule-visibility.md).

[`scene-observe.bend`](../src/scene-observe.bend) consumes and reconstructs the
application around a read-only inspector. Snapshots and drawing data may outlive
the observation. Rendering or replaying them cannot restore an older scene.

## Future chunk integration

The selected model keeps ECS as the persistent owner. Chunk layout is an internal
storage choice. A work batch describes computation over that storage and need
not have the same boundaries as a storage chunk.

A future transfer API must represent these conditions in its types and checked
operations before production simulation uses it:

1. The simulation adapter consumes the owner or an exclusive storage capability.
   Partitioning transfers payload ownership. It does not clone canonical fields
   into a second persistent container.
2. Each task receives exclusive access to its assigned partition. Partition
   membership covers the selected entities without overlap. Entity handles retain
   their namespace and generation and do not become unchecked physical indexes.
3. While tasks hold partitions, the remaining coordinator cannot obtain an ECS
   reader or writer for those partitions. A usable world and writable detached
   chunks must never coexist for the same components.
4. Cross-partition reads use a specified read-only representation, such as a
   bounded snapshot from tick start. That representation carries no writeback
   permission. Its phase and copy costs are part of the algorithm's contract.
5. Completion returns each owned partition through the same adapter before
   ordinary ECS access and extraction resume. A refused or cancelled operation
   must account for every partition and define the resulting authoritative state.
6. Structural changes that invalidate partition membership or storage addresses
   wait for ownership to return. Their publication order follows the explicit
   schedule contract. Render extraction observes a completed state boundary.

These are requirements for a future API, not descriptions of a shipped lease or
split operation. The pinned dependency's `chunk-column.Column` is an affine
storage implementation. Its existence does not establish a safe Entangle task
handoff. If exclusive transfer cannot be expressed, simulation remains sequential
through the current ECS writer. Independently allocated chunks may be canonical
storage if the world owns them without retaining writable duplicate columns.

R0 may run a standalone numerical reference from copied initial values. That is
a separate execution for comparison, not a live mirror with a writeback path.
CPU or GPU dispatch changes execution only. The ownership and numerical contract
must remain the same without GPU dispatch.

## Excluded designs and trusted boundary

A permanent ECS store plus a mutable simulation mirror violates this contract,
even if a scheduler runs their writers sequentially or synchronizes them every
frame. The contract also excludes restoring a retained draw list, snapshot, or
neighbor halo as current component state.

Moving persistent authority outside ECS would require a separate design change.
That change must remove writable ECS storage for those fields, expose derived
read projections, and route edits as commands to the simulation owner. A second
store cannot be introduced as an incremental compatibility path.

Trusted provisioning code can construct raw world records and register writers.
The current public Bendvy constructors do not make this repository an opaque
capability sandbox. The contract constrains those callers too. The affine checker
prevents owner reuse, but it does not forbid an engineer from adding a new store.
Future chunk integration therefore needs production-path ownership checks and
must remove any duplicate writer path in the same change.

type Evidence is Type:
  Evidence{app:Scene.Application(),instance:I.Instance<D.Schema>,completed:U32,
    baseline:List<&2,Reference.Identity>,previous:List<&2,Observe.Row>,retained:Draw.DrawList}

def drawn(completed:U32,baseline:List<&2,Reference.Identity>,+values:List<&2,Observe.Row>,
  result:Scene.Application() & (I.Instance<D.Schema> & Result<&2,&2,Unit,Draw.DrawList>)) -> IO(Evidence):
  match result:
    case (app,(instance,Done{Draw.DrawList{+items}})):
      do IO<Evidence>:
        Reference.require(Reference.drawing_equal(items,values),"headless drawing differs from scene")
        return Evidence{app,instance,completed,baseline,values,Draw.DrawList{items}}
    case _:IO.die(Evidence,1,"headless drawing refused")

def drawing(completed:U32,baseline:List<&2,Reference.Identity>,+values:List<&2,Observe.Row>,
  app:Scene.Application(),instance:I.Instance<D.Schema>) -> IO(Evidence):
  drawn(completed,baseline,values,Observe.draw_list(app,instance))

def captured(+completed:U32,baseline:List<&2,Reference.Identity>,+previous:List<&2,Observe.Row>,
  +receipts:List<&2,W.Handle<D.Schema>>,
  result:Scene.Application() & (I.Instance<D.Schema> & Result<&2,&2,Unit,Observe.Snapshot>)) -> IO(Evidence):
  match result:
    case (app,(instance,Done{+snapshot})):
      Observe.Snapshot{+live,+admitted,_,_,+values} = snapshot
      +baseline = Reference.baseline_at(baseline,admitted)
      do IO<Evidence>:
        Reference.validate(completed,baseline,snapshot)
        Reference.require(Reference.same(receipts,admitted) && Reference.same(receipts,live) &&
          Reference.same(receipts,Reference.row_handles(values)),"headless receipt identities differ")
        Reference.recurrence(values,previous,baseline,U32.is_eq(completed,1))
        drawn : Evidence <- drawing(completed,baseline,values,app,instance)
        IO.pure(Evidence,drawn)
    case _:IO.die(Evidence,1,"headless production observation refused")

+## Semantics and ownership
+
+Each scene instance has one optional parent, identified by its zero-based source
+instance index. Forward references are allowed. Roots have no parent. The graph
+must be a forest. Self-parenting, cycles, and missing parents are errors.
+Runtime edits use full Bendvy entity handles, including namespace and generation.
+An absent parent detaches the object. Reparenting preserves the local transform.
+It may change the object's world position. There is no preserve-world operation.
+Runtime spawn and despawn remain outside this API.
+
+Local transforms use column vectors and `T * R * S`. A root's GlobalTransform is
+its local model matrix. A child's matrix is `parent_global * child_local`.
+GlobalTransform retains the complete affine matrix, including shear. It is never
+decomposed back into rotation and scale. World bounds enclose the eight transformed
+corners of the source mesh AABB. They bound that object's geometry, not its subtree.
+Empty geometry has empty bounds. Lighting uses the inverse transpose of the
+world linear transform. A singular transform is allowed for unlit geometry;
+textured geometry requires a finite, numerically usable inverse.
+
+Creation descriptions are immutable inputs. The ECS owns local transforms,
+parent relationships, source bounds, and derived state. A completed tick or
+accepted public edit publishes a consistent set of local transforms, globals,
+and bounds. GlobalTransform and world bounds have no public setter. Detached
+observations and render lists cannot write back to the world. A last-accepted
+local value retained with derived state is a rollback checkpoint, not a second
+simulation authority.
+
+The baseline recomputes the complete forest sequentially at each publication
+boundary. Validation and derivation finish before public edits write components.
+A rejected public edit preserves the complete world. If a scheduled transform
+update makes derivation invalid, local transforms return to their last accepted
+values and existing derived values remain valid. Schedule administrative progress
+is retained. The persistent RenderScene and incremental invalidation belong to E5.
+

+`None{}` makes a root. Existing `Instance{mesh,material,transform}` remains a root.

+return the owned application beside an acceptance result. Invalid or stale
+handles, invalid transforms, and invalid derived state return a diagnostic.
+The same operations are available for the mesh application.
+
+Version 1 JSON retains existing flat scenes. An optional `parent` is a zero-based
+placement index or null. Every part of a model placement shares that placement's
+local transform. Its first part is the parent anchor; remaining parts attach to
+the anchor with identity local transforms. This expansion is used only for scenes
+with parent links, so old flat instance order and transform behavior remain intact.

+serve as anchors. Unknown fields and invalid references remain errors.

+import Base
+import ./components.bend as C
+import ./scene-matrix.bend as M
+import ./content.bend as F
+
+type Bounds is Data:
+  Empty{}
+  Bounds{minimum:C.Vec3,maximum:C.Vec3}
+type GlobalTransform is Data:
+  GlobalTransform{matrix:M.Mat4}
+type Local is Data:
+  Local{transform:C.Transform,parent:Maybe<&2,U32>,bounds:Bounds,lit:Bool}
+type Spatial is Data:
+  Spatial{accepted:Local,global:GlobalTransform,bounds:Bounds}
+type Error is Data:
+  MissingParent{index:U32}
+  Cycle{index:U32}
+  InvalidTransform{index:U32}
+  MissingEntity{}
+type Mark is Data:
+  Pending{local:Local}
+  Visiting{}
+  Finished{value:Spatial}
+
+def col_finite(v:M.Vec4) -> Bool:
+  M.Vec4{x,y,z,w} = v
+  F.finite(x) && F.finite(y) && F.finite(z) && F.finite(w)
+
+def matrix_finite(m:M.Mat4) -> Bool:
+  M.Mat4{a,b,c,d} = m
+  col_finite(a) && col_finite(b) && col_finite(c) && col_finite(d)
+
+def transform_valid(t:C.Transform) -> Bool:
+  C.Transform{p,C.Quat{+x,+y,+z,+w},s} = t
+  +n = (x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w : F32)
+  F.vec_finite(p) && F.vec_finite(s) && F.finite(x) && F.finite(y) && F.finite(z) && F.finite(w) && F32.is_ge(n,0.9999) && F32.is_le(n,1.0001)
+
+def cross(a:C.Vec3,b:C.Vec3) -> C.Vec3:
+  C.Vec3{+x,+y,+z} = a
+  C.Vec3{+u,+v,+w} = b
+  C.Vec3{(y * w - z * v : F32),(z * u - x * w : F32),(x * v - y * u : F32)}
+
+def dot(a:C.Vec3,b:C.Vec3) -> F32:
+  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = a
+  C.Vec3{u,v,w} = b
+  (x * u + y * v + z * w : F32)
+
+def xyz(v:M.Vec4) -> C.Vec3:
+  M.Vec4{x,y,z,_} = v
+  C.Vec3{x,y,z}
+
+def divide(v:C.Vec3,+d:F32) -> M.Vec4:
+  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = v
+  M.Vec4{F32.div(x,d),F32.div(y,d),F32.div(z,d),0.0}
+
+def normal_checked(ok:Bool,+matrix:M.Mat4) -> Maybe<&2,M.Mat4>:
+  match ok:
+    case True{}:Some{matrix}
+    case False{}:None{}
+
+def inverse_columns(+a:C.Vec3,+b:C.Vec3,+c:C.Vec3) -> Maybe<&2,M.Mat4>:
+  +x = cross(b,c)
+  +det = dot(a,x)
+  +matrix = M.Mat4{divide(x,det),divide(cross(c,a),det),divide(cross(a,b),det),M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0}}
+  normal_checked(F32.is_ge(F32.abs(det),1e-30) && matrix_finite(matrix),matrix)
+
+def normal(global:GlobalTransform) -> Maybe<&2,M.Mat4>:
+  GlobalTransform{M.Mat4{a,b,c,_}} = global
+  inverse_columns(xyz(a),xyz(b),xyz(c))
+
+def usable_normal(value:Maybe<&2,M.Mat4>) -> Bool:
+  match value:
+    case None{}:False{}
+    case Some{M.Mat4{+a,+b,+c,_}}:
+      +x = dot(xyz(a),xyz(a))
+      +y = dot(xyz(b),xyz(b))
+      +z = dot(xyz(c),xyz(c))
+      F32.is_ge(x,1e-24) && F32.is_le(x,1e24) && F32.is_ge(y,1e-24) && F32.is_le(y,1e24) && F32.is_ge(z,1e-24) && F32.is_le(z,1e24)
+
+def affine(global:GlobalTransform) -> Bool:
+  GlobalTransform{+m} = global
+  M.Mat4{M.Vec4{_,_,_,a},M.Vec4{_,_,_,b},M.Vec4{_,_,_,c},M.Vec4{_,_,_,d}} = m
+  matrix_finite(m) && F32.is_eq(a,0.0) && F32.is_eq(b,0.0) && F32.is_eq(c,0.0) && F32.is_eq(d,1.0)
+
+def compose(parent:Maybe<&2,GlobalTransform>,local:C.Transform) -> GlobalTransform:
+  match parent:
+    case None{}:GlobalTransform{M.model(local)}
+    case Some{GlobalTransform{matrix}}:GlobalTransform{M.multiply(matrix,M.model(local))}
+
+def include(bounds:Bounds,+point:C.Vec3) -> Bounds:
+  C.Vec3{+x,+y,+z} = point
+  match bounds:
+    case Empty{}:Bounds{point,point}
+    case Bounds{C.Vec3{a,b,c},C.Vec3{d,e,f}}:
+      Bounds{C.Vec3{F32.min(a,x),F32.min(b,y),F32.min(c,z)},C.Vec3{F32.max(d,x),F32.max(e,y),F32.max(f,z)}}
+
+def vertex_bounds(vertices:List<&2,F.Vertex>,bounds:Bounds) -> Bounds:
+  match vertices:
+    case []:bounds
+    case F.Vertex{point,_,_,_} <> rest:vertex_bounds(rest,include(bounds,point))
+
+def mesh_bounds(mesh:F.Mesh) -> Bounds:
+  F.Mesh{vertices,_} = mesh
+  vertex_bounds(vertices,Empty{})
+
+def corners(bounds:Bounds) -> List<&2,C.Vec3>:
+  match bounds:
+    case Empty{}:[]
+    case Bounds{C.Vec3{+a,+b,+c},C.Vec3{+d,+e,+f}}:
+      [C.Vec3{a,b,c},C.Vec3{a,b,f},C.Vec3{a,e,c},C.Vec3{a,e,f},C.Vec3{d,b,c},C.Vec3{d,b,f},C.Vec3{d,e,c},C.Vec3{d,e,f}]
+
+def point(matrix:M.Mat4,p:C.Vec3) -> C.Vec3:
+  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = p
+  xyz(M.apply(matrix,M.Vec4{x,y,z,1.0}))
+
+def transformed(points:List<&2,C.Vec3>,+matrix:M.Mat4,bounds:Bounds) -> Bounds:
+  match points:
+    case []:bounds
+    case p <> rest:transformed(rest,matrix,include(bounds,point(matrix,p)))
+
+def world_bounds(global:GlobalTransform,bounds:Bounds) -> Bounds:
+  GlobalTransform{matrix} = global
+  transformed(corners(bounds),matrix,Empty{})
+
+def bounds_valid(bounds:Bounds) -> Bool:
+  match bounds:
+    case Empty{}:True{}
+    case Bounds{+a,+b}:
+      C.Vec3{x,y,z} = a
+      C.Vec3{u,v,w} = b
+      F.vec_finite(a) && F.vec_finite(b) && F32.is_le(x,u) && F32.is_le(y,v) && F32.is_le(z,w)
+
+def derived(ok:Bool,number:U32,local:Local,global:GlobalTransform,bounds:Bounds) -> Result<&2,&2,Error,Spatial>:
+  match ok:
+    case False{}:Fail{InvalidTransform{number}}
+    case True{}:Done{Spatial{local,global,bounds}}
+
+def derive(+local:Local,parent:Maybe<&2,GlobalTransform>,number:U32) -> Result<&2,&2,Error,Spatial>:
+  Local{+t,_,+bounds,+lit} = local
+  +global = compose(parent,t)
+  +world = world_bounds(global,bounds)
+  derived(transform_valid(t) && affine(global) && bounds_valid(bounds) && bounds_valid(world) && (Bool.not(lit) || usable_normal(normal(global))),number,local,global,world)
+
+def initialized(+local:Local) -> Spatial:
+  Local{t,_,bounds,_} = local
+  +global = compose(None{},t)
+  Spatial{local,global,world_bounds(global,bounds)}
+

def window_matrix() -> M.Mat4:
  M.Mat4{M.Vec4{0.25,0.0,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,F32.neg(0.5),0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,0.125,0.0},M.Vec4{F32.neg(0.25),0.25,0.5,1.0}}

def checked(camera:Maybe<Create.Camera>,renderer:Win.Renderer,snapshot:V.WindowSnapshot,+list:Draw.DrawList) -> V.Action(Maybe<Win.Renderer>):
  match camera:
    case None{}:
      do V.Action<Maybe<Win.Renderer>>:
        Win.close(renderer)
        return None{}
    case Some{_}:
      do V.Action<Maybe<Win.Renderer>>:
        pair:Win.Renderer & Result<&2,&2,Win.InputError,Unit> <- Win.frame(renderer,snapshot,w => h => Some{window_matrix()},list)
        renderer:Win.Renderer <- Error.owner(Win.Renderer,Win.InputError,Unit,pair,"Public window drawing rejected")

def polled(pair:Win.Renderer & V.WindowSnapshot,+list:Draw.DrawList) -> V.Action(Maybe<Win.Renderer>):

  V.WindowSnapshot{width,height,mapped,focused,captured,events} = snapshot
  checked(Input.events(events,Some{Create.default_camera()}),renderer,V.WindowSnapshot{width,height,mapped,focused,captured,[]},list)

def loop(fuel:Nat,renderer:Maybe<Win.Renderer>,+list:Draw.DrawList) -> V.Action(Unit):

    case 0n Some{renderer}:Win.close(renderer)
    case 1n+rest Some{renderer}:
      do V.Action<Unit>:
        pair:Win.Renderer & V.WindowSnapshot <- Win.poll(renderer)
        next:Maybe<Win.Renderer> <- polled(pair,list)
        loop(rest,next,list)

def colors(pixels:List<&2,U32>,+channel:U32) -> U32:
  match pixels:
    case []:0
    case +p <> rest:
      +r = U32.and((p >> 16n : U32),255)
      +g = U32.and((p >> 8n : U32),255)
      +b = U32.and(p,255)
      +bright = Bool.pick(U32,U32.is_zero(channel),r,Bool.pick(U32,U32.is_eq(channel,1),g,b))
      +others = Bool.pick(U32,U32.is_zero(channel),U32.max(g,b),Bool.pick(U32,U32.is_eq(channel,1),U32.max(r,b),U32.max(r,g)))
      U32.add(Bool.to_u32(U32.is_gt(bright,40) && U32.is_lt(others,8)),colors(rest,channel))

def populated(frame:Pixels.Frame) -> IO(Unit):
  Pixels.Frame{_,_,+pixels} = frame
  Check.assert(U32.is_gt(colors(pixels,0),200) && U32.is_gt(colors(pixels,1),200) && U32.is_gt(colors(pixels,2),200),"Textured window lacks sampled red, green or blue regions")

    +display:String <- IO.try(String,IO.get_env("DISPLAY"))
    layers:String <- IO.try(String,IO.get_env("VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS"))
    sync:String <- IO.try(String,IO.get_env("VK_LAYER_VALIDATE_SYNC"))
    Check.assert(String.contains(layers,"VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation") && String.eq(sync,"1"),"Textured window requires validation")
    +pid:U32 <- IO.try(U32,Host.start("build/window-evidence/native.log",False{}))
    +id:U32 <- Existing.wait_window(300n,pid)
    IO.try(Unit,Host.control(id,2,0,0))
    +first:Pixels.Frame <- Window.wait(pid,id,Window.Populated{640,480})
    populated(first)
    Window.save("initial",first)
    Window.controls([97,100,119,115,113,101],display,pid,id,first)
    +reset:Pixels.Frame <- Window.wait(pid,id,Window.Exact{first})
    Window.save("reset",reset)
    Window.resize([(800,600),(480,640),(640,480),(480,640),(640,480)],display,pid,id,[first])
    IO.try(Unit,Host.control(id,1,0,0))

    IO.try(Unit,Host.control(id,2,0,0))
    Window.key(display,id,100)
    _:Pixels.Frame <- Window.wait(pid,id,Window.Moved{first})
    Window.key(display,id,114)

def camera() -> M.Mat4:
  M.Mat4{M.Vec4{1.0,0.0,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,1.0,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,1.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0}}

def light() -> Light.Light:
  Light.Directional{C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,1.0},C.Vec3{1.0,1.0,1.0},0.0,1.0}

def pixel(+x:U32,+y:U32,+level:U32) -> List<&2,U32>:
  +inside = U32.is_ge(x,8) && U32.is_lt(x,56) && U32.is_ge(y,8) && U32.is_lt(y,56)
  +right = U32.is_ge(x,32)
  +bottom = U32.is_ge(y,32)
  Bool.pick(List<&2,U32>,inside,[Bool.pick(U32,Bool.xor(right,bottom),0,level),Bool.pick(U32,right,level,0),Bool.pick(U32,bottom,level,0),255],[0,0,255,255])

def check(rgba:List<&2,U32>,depth:List<&2,U32>,+index:U32,+level:U32) -> Bool:
  match rgba depth:
    case [],[]:U32.is_eq(index,4096)
    case r <> g <> b <> a <> rest,d0 <> d1 <> d2 <> d3 <> ds:
      +x = U32.mod(index,64)
      +y = U32.div(index,64)
      +inside = U32.is_ge(x,8) && U32.is_lt(x,56) && U32.is_ge(y,8) && U32.is_lt(y,56)
      F.same_indices([r,g,b,a],pixel(x,y,level)) && U32.is_zero(d0) && U32.is_zero(d1) && U32.is_eq(d2,128) && U32.is_eq(d3,Bool.pick(U32,inside,62,63)) && check(rest,ds,U32.inc(index),level)
    case _,_:False{}

def observed(pair:R.Renderer & Result<&2,&2,R.InputError,R.Readback>,level:U32,+label:String) -> V.Action(R.Renderer):
  match pair:
    case (renderer,Done{R.Readback{64,64,rgba,depth}}):
      do V.Action<R.Renderer>:
        Error.require(check(rgba,depth,0,level),label ++ ": full RGBA/D32 differs")
        V.Action.lift(Unit,IO.print(label ++ ": every color and depth byte matches"))
        return renderer
    case _:Error.failure(R.Renderer,1,label ++ ": frame rejected")

def frame(renderer:R.Renderer,draws:Draw.DrawList,level:U32,label:String) -> V.Action(R.Renderer):
  do V.Action<R.Renderer>:
    pair:R.Renderer & Result<&2,&2,R.InputError,R.Readback> <- R.render(renderer,draws)
    observed(pair,level,label)

def changed(pair:R.Renderer & Bool) -> V.Action(R.Renderer):
  match pair:
    case (renderer,True{}):V.Action.pure(R.Renderer,renderer)
    case _:Error.failure(R.Renderer,1,"Valid light rejected")

def rejected_light(pair:R.Renderer & Bool) -> V.Action(R.Renderer):
  match pair:
    case (renderer,False{}):V.Action.pure(R.Renderer,renderer)
    case _:Error.failure(R.Renderer,1,"Zero light direction accepted")

def rejected_transform(pair:R.Renderer & Result<&2,&2,R.InputError,R.Readback>) -> V.Action(R.Renderer):
  match pair:
    case (renderer,Fail{R.InvalidTransform{0}}):V.Action.pure(R.Renderer,renderer)
    case _:Error.failure(R.Renderer,1,"Singular textured transform accepted")

def run(entry:V.Entry,compiled:Create.Compiled) -> V.Action(Unit):
  Create.Compiled{seeds,geometry} = compiled
  +draws:Draw.DrawList = Draw.DrawList{Content.draws(seeds)}
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    renderer:R.Renderer <- R.create(entry,R.Config{64,64,camera(),light()},geometry)

    renderer:R.Renderer <- rejected_light(R.set_light(renderer,Light.Directional{C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,0.0},C.Vec3{1.0,1.0,1.0},0.0,1.0}))

    renderer:R.Renderer <- rejected_transform(rejected)

    renderer:R.Renderer <- changed(R.set_light(renderer,Light.Directional{C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,F32.neg(1.0)},C.Vec3{1.0,1.0,1.0},0.0,1.0}))

def vertices(words:List<U32>) -> List<&2,F.Vertex>:
  match words:

def tick_one_framing(width:U32,height:U32) -> M.Mat4:
  tick_one_center_x : F32 = 50.5
  tick_one_center_y : F32 = 99.5
  tick_one_center_z : F32 = F32.neg(51.5)
  +s = (3.0 * F32.min(1.0,F32.div(U32.to_f32(width),U32.to_f32(height))) / 130.0 : F32)
  M.Mat4{M.Vec4{s,0.0,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,s,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,s,0.0},M.Vec4{F32.neg((s * tick_one_center_x : F32)),F32.neg((s * tick_one_center_y : F32)),F32.neg((s * tick_one_center_z : F32)),1.0}}

def composed(matrix:Maybe<M.Mat4>,width:U32,height:U32) -> Maybe<M.Mat4>:
  match matrix:
    case None{}:None{}
    case Some{camera}:Some{M.multiply(camera,tick_one_framing(width,height))}

def view(camera:Create.Camera,+width:U32,+height:U32) -> Maybe<M.Mat4>:

def fold(words:List<U32>,hash:U32) -> U32:
  match words:
    case []:hash
    case word <> rest:fold(rest,U32.mul(U32.xor(hash,word),16777619))

def digest(items:List<&2,Draw.DrawItem>,hash:U32) -> U32:

    case []:hash
    case Draw.DrawItem{C.Transform{C.Vec3{x,y,z},C.Quat{a,b,c,d},C.Vec3{sx,sy,sz}},C.MeshRef{id}} <> rest:

def extracted(pair:Scene.Application() & (I.Instance<D.Schema> & Draw.DrawList),+baseline:List<&2,Check.Identity>,+rows:List<&2,Observe.Row>,+tick:U32,clock:Time.Clock,retained:Draw.DrawList,saved:List<&2,Observe.Row>) -> V.Action(State):

        extracted(pair,identities,rows,tick,clock,retained,saved)
    case (app,(inspector,Done{Observe.Snapshot{+live,+admitted,+exhausted,+clean,+rows}})), +identities:
      do V.Action<State>:
        V.Action.lift(Unit,Check.validate(tick,identities,Observe.Snapshot{live,admitted,exhausted,clean,rows}))
        pair : Scene.Application() & (I.Instance<D.Schema> & Draw.DrawList) <- Extract.observe(app,inspector)
        extracted(pair,identities,rows,tick,clock,retained,saved)
    case _, _:IO.pure(V.VkResult(State),Fail{(1,"Window scene observation refused")})

def retain(state:State) -> State:
  State{app,inspector,baseline,+rows,+draws,retained,saved,tick,clock} = state
  State{app,inspector,baseline,rows,draws,draws,rows,tick,clock}

def advance(state:State) -> V.Action(State):
  State{app,inspector,baseline,+rows,Draw.DrawList{+items},Draw.DrawList{+held},+saved,+tick,clock} = state
  do V.Action<State>:
    Error.require(Check.drawing_equal(items,rows) && Check.drawing_equal(held,saved),"Retained original drawing bits changed")
    app : Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),Scene.tick(app))
    observed(Observe.snapshot(app,inspector),baseline,U32.inc(tick),clock,Draw.DrawList{held},saved)

def steps(remaining:Nat,state:State) -> V.Action(State):
  match remaining:
    case 0n:V.Action.pure(State,state)
    case 1n+rest:
      do V.Action<State>:
        state:State <- advance(state)
        steps(rest,state)

def schedule(state:State,now:Nat) -> State & Time.Batch:
  State{app,inspector,baseline,rows,draws,retained,saved,tick,clock} = state
  +batch = Time.poll(Time.defaults(),clock,now)
  (State{app,inspector,baseline,rows,draws,retained,saved,tick,Time.clock(batch)},batch)

def captured(rebuild:D.World() -> Scene.Application(),pair:D.World() & Result<&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,HW.Row>>) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  match pair:
    case (world,Done{rows}):IO.pure(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,(rebuild(world),rows))
    case _:IO.die(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,1,"Hierarchy ECS observation failed")

def capture(app:Scene.Application()) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred} = app
  captured(world => Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred},HW.read(world))

def at(rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,index:Nat) -> Maybe<&2,HW.Row>:
  match rows index:
    case row <> _,0n:Some{row}
    case _ <> rest,1n+n:at(rest,n)
    case [] _:None{}

def entity(value:Maybe<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(W.Handle<D.Schema>):
  match value:
    case Some{HW.Row{entity,_,_,_}}:IO.pure(W.Handle<D.Schema>,entity)
    case _:IO.die(W.Handle<D.Schema>,1,"Missing oracle entity")

def close(+a:F32,+b:F32) -> Bool:
  F.finite(a) && F.finite(b) && F32.is_le(F32.abs(F32.sub(a,b)),F32.mul(0.0001,F32.max(1.0,F32.max(F32.abs(a),F32.abs(b)))))

def vec(a:C.Vec3,b:C.Vec3) -> Bool:
  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = a
  C.Vec3{u,v,w} = b
  close(x,u) && close(y,v) && close(z,w)

# Independent oracle applies local scale and quaternion rotation to a point,
# then walks parents. It never composes model matrices.
def local_point(t:C.Transform,p:C.Vec3) -> C.Vec3:
  C.Transform{C.Vec3{tx,ty,tz},C.Quat{+qx,+qy,+qz,+qw},C.Vec3{sx,sy,sz}} = t
  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = p
  +x = F32.mul(x,sx)
  +y = F32.mul(y,sy)
  +z = F32.mul(z,sz)
  +rx = (2.0 * (qy * z - qz * y) : F32)
  +ry = (2.0 * (qz * x - qx * z) : F32)
  +rz = (2.0 * (qx * y - qy * x) : F32)
  C.Vec3{(tx + x + qw * rx + qy * rz - qz * ry : F32),(ty + y + qw * ry + qz * rx - qx * rz : F32),(tz + z + qw * rz + qx * ry - qy * rx : F32)}

def follow(parent:Maybe<&2,U32>,p:C.Vec3,next:U32 -> C.Vec3 -> Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>) -> Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>:
  match parent:
    case None{}:Some{p}
    case Some{n}:next(n,p)

def walk_row(row:Maybe<&2,HW.Row>,p:C.Vec3,next:U32 -> C.Vec3 -> Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>) -> Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>:
  match row:
    case None{}:None{}
    case Some{HW.Row{_,t,_,H.Spatial{H.Local{_,parent,_,_},_,_}}}:follow(parent,local_point(t,p),next)

def walk(fuel:Nat,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,index:U32,p:C.Vec3) -> Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>:
  match fuel:
    case 0n:None{}
    case 1n+n:walk_row(at(rows,U32.to_nat(index)),p,i => p => walk(n,rows,i,p))

def matches(expected:Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>,actual:C.Vec3) -> Bool:
  match expected:
    case None{}:False{}
    case Some{p}:vec(p,actual)

def points(points:List<&2,C.Vec3>,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32,+global:H.GlobalTransform) -> Bool:
  match points:
    case []:True{}
    case +p <> rest:matches(walk(1n+List.length(&2,HW.Row,rows),rows,index,p),H.point(H.matrix(global),p)) && points(rest,rows,index,global)

def expected_include(value:Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>,bounds:Maybe<&2,H.Bounds>) -> Maybe<&2,H.Bounds>:
  match value bounds:
    case Some{p} Some{b}:Some{H.include(b,p)}
    case _ _:None{}

def expected_bounds(corners:List<&2,C.Vec3>,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32) -> Maybe<&2,H.Bounds>:
  match corners:
    case []:Some{H.Empty{}}
    case p <> rest:expected_include(walk(1n+List.length(&2,HW.Row,rows),rows,index,p),expected_bounds(rest,rows,index))

def bounds(expected:Maybe<&2,H.Bounds>,actual:H.Bounds) -> Bool:
  match expected actual:
    case Some{H.Empty{}} H.Empty{}:True{}
    case Some{H.Bounds{a,b}} H.Bounds{c,d}:vec(a,c) && vec(b,d)
    case _ _:False{}

def pose_words(t:C.Transform) -> List<&2,U32>:
  C.Transform{C.Vec3{x,y,z},C.Quat{a,b,c,d},C.Vec3{sx,sy,sz}} = t
  [F32.bits(x),F32.bits(y),F32.bits(z),F32.bits(a),F32.bits(b),F32.bits(c),F32.bits(d),F32.bits(sx),F32.bits(sy),F32.bits(sz)]

def same_pose(a:C.Transform,b:C.Transform) -> Bool:F.same_indices(pose_words(a),pose_words(b))

def verify_rows(todo:List<&2,HW.Row>,+all:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32) -> IO(Unit):
  match todo:
    case []:IO.pure(Unit,Unit{})
    case HW.Row{_,+t,_,H.Spatial{H.Local{accepted,_,+local,_},+global,b}} <> rest:
      do IO<Unit>:
        S.require(same_pose(t,accepted),"Hierarchy accepted local differs from ECS Transform")
        S.require(points([C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,0.0},C.Vec3{1.0,0.0,0.0},C.Vec3{0.0,1.0,0.0},C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,1.0}],all,index,global),"Hierarchy world position/composition differs from independent point oracle")
        S.require(bounds(expected_bounds(H.corners(local),all,index),b),"Hierarchy world bounds differ from independent corner oracle")
        verify_rows(rest,all,U32.inc(index))

def words(values:List<U32>) -> String:
  match values:
    case []:""
    case value <> rest:U32.show(value) ++ "," ++ words(rest)

def data_words(values:List<&2,U32>) -> String:
  match values:
    case []:""
    case value <> rest:U32.show(value) ++ "," ++ data_words(rest)

def vec_words(v:C.Vec3) -> String:
  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = v
  data_words([F32.bits(x),F32.bits(y),F32.bits(z)])

def bound_words(b:H.Bounds) -> String:
  match b:
    case H.Empty{}:"empty"
    case H.Bounds{a,b}:vec_words(a) ++ vec_words(b)

def parent_words(p:Maybe<&2,U32>) -> String:
  match p:
    case None{}:"root"
    case Some{n}:U32.show(n)

def row_words(row:HW.Row) -> String:
  HW.Row{W.Handle{ns,Key.Key{id,gen}},t,C.MeshRef{mesh},H.Spatial{H.Local{accepted,p,b,lit},global,wb}} = row
  data_words([ns,id,gen,mesh,Bool.to_u32(lit)]) ++ data_words(pose_words(t)) ++ data_words(pose_words(accepted)) ++ parent_words(p) ++ ";" ++ bound_words(b) ++ ";" ++ words(M.matrix_words(H.matrix(global))) ++ bound_words(wb)

def state(rows:List<&2,HW.Row>) -> String:
  match rows:
    case []:""
    case row <> rest:row_words(row) ++ "|" ++ state(rest)

def checked(pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  (app,+rows) = pair
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    verify_rows(rows,rows,0)
    return (app,rows)

def observe(app:Scene.Application()) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- capture(app)
    checked(pair)

def accepted(pair:Scene.Application() & Result<&2,&2,H.Error,Unit>,expected:Bool) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  match pair:
    case (app,Done{_}):
      do IO<Scene.Application()>:
        S.require(expected,"Invalid hierarchy edit was accepted")
        return app
    case (app,Fail{_}):
      do IO<Scene.Application()>:
        S.require(Bool.not(expected),"Valid hierarchy edit was rejected")
        return app
EOF
bend tools/hierarchy/check.bend

# Detached entity slot index and generation. This key has no world namespace
# or liveness proof; use a World.Handle and checked operations for authority.
# Generation wrap follows the allocator contract, not eternal key uniqueness.
type Key is Data:
  EntityKey{index:U32,generation:U32}

# Return only the slot index, discarding generation for this observation.
# Equal indices do not establish equal entity identities or valid handles.
def index(key:Key) -> U32:

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > tools/hierarchy/drive.bend <<'EOF'
import Base
import ./check.bend as Check
import ./scenes.bend as Scenes
import ../../src/scene.bend as Scene
import ../../src/creation.bend as Create
import ../../src/scene-schema.bend as D
import ../../src/scene-hierarchy.bend as HW
import ../../src/components.bend as C
import ../../src/hierarchy.bend as H
import ../../src/scene-matrix.bend as M
import ../../deps/bendvy/src/ecs/world.bend as W
import ../verify-creation.bend as Consumer
import ../upload-boundary/scan.bend as S

def foreign(entity:W.Handle<D.Schema>) -> W.Handle<D.Schema>:
  W.Handle{namespace,key} = entity
  W.Handle{U32.inc(namespace),key}

def action(code:U32,app:Scene.Application(),+root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+child:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+branch:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+other:W.Handle<D.Schema>,deep:W.Handle<D.Schema>) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  match code:
    case 0:
      do IO<Scene.Application()>:
        app:Scene.Application() <- Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,child,Some{root}),True{})
        app:Scene.Application() <- Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.root()),True{})
        Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,child,Scenes.child()),True{})
    case 1:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(0.1,0.1,0.5,Scenes.rotation(),C.Vec3{0.8,0.6,0.5})),True{})
    case 2:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(F32.neg(0.3),0.0,0.5,C.Quat{0.0,0.0,0.6,0.8},C.Vec3{0.8,0.6,0.5})),True{})
    case 3:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(F32.neg(0.3),0.0,0.5,Scenes.rotation(),C.Vec3{1.2,0.4,0.8})),True{})
    case 4:Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,child,Some{other}),True{})
    case 5:Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,child,None{}),True{})
    case 6:Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,child,Some{child}),False{})
    case 7:Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,root,Some{deep}),False{})
    case 8:Check.accepted(Scene.set_parent(app,child,Some{foreign(root)}),False{})
    case 9:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(0.0,0.0,0.5,Scenes.rotation(),C.Vec3{0.0,1.0,1.0})),False{})
    case 10:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(M.float_word(2139095040),0.0,0.5,Scenes.rotation(),Scenes.unit())),False{})
    case 11:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,foreign(root),Scenes.root()),False{})
    case 12:Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,branch,Scenes.pose(0.0,0.8,0.0,C.Quat{0.6,0.0,0.0,0.8},C.Vec3{0.3,0.3,0.3})),True{})
    case 13:Scene.tick(app)
    case _:IO.die(Scene.Application(),1,"Unknown hierarchy replay command")

def independent(before:List<&2,HW.Row>,after:List<&2,HW.Row>) -> Bool:
  match before after:
    case [_,_,_,a,_] [_,_,_,b,_]:String.eq(Check.row_words(a),Check.row_words(b))
    case _ _:False{}

def verified(+code:U32,+before:List<&2,HW.Row>,pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  (app,+rows) = pair
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    S.require(Bool.pick(Bool,U32.is_ge(code,6) && U32.is_le(code,11),String.eq(Check.state(before),Check.state(rows)),True{}),"Rejected hierarchy edit changed complete ECS state")
    S.require(U32.is_eq(code,13) || independent(before,rows),"Hierarchy edit changed independent branch")
    IO.print("hierarchy-step=" ++ U32.show(code) ++ " state=" ++ Check.state(rows))
    return (app,rows)

def step(+code:U32,pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  (app,+before) = pair
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    root:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(before,0n))
    child:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(before,1n))
    branch:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(before,2n))
    other:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(before,3n))
    deep:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(before,4n))
    app:Scene.Application() <- action(code,app,root,child,branch,other,deep)
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- Check.observe(app)
    verified(code,before,pair)

def start(compiled:Create.Compiled) -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  Create.Compiled{seeds,_} = compiled
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.create(seeds)
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.tick(app)
    Check.observe(app)

def boot() -> IO(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>):
  do IO<Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>>:
    compiled:Create.Compiled <- Consumer.compiled(Create.compile(Scenes.showcase()))
    start(compiled)

import Base
import ./check.bend as Check
import ./drive.bend as Drive
import ./scenes.bend as Scenes
import ../../src/components.bend as C
import ../../src/content.bend as F
import ../../src/creation.bend as Create
import ../../src/scene.bend as Scene
import ../../src/scene-hierarchy.bend as HW
import ../../src/scene-render.bend as R
import ../../src/scene-draw.bend as Draw
import ../../src/scene-matrix.bend as M
import ../../src/lighting.bend as Light
import ../../src/error.bend as Error
import ../../src/app.bend as Scope
import ../../deps/bend-vulkan/Vulkan.bend as V
import ../../examples/scene-render.bend as Existing
import ../verify-creation.bend as Consumer
import ../verify-textured-render.bend as Pixel
import ../verify-textured-transforms.bend as Transform

def unpack(p:Maybe<&2,C.Vec3>) -> C.Vec3:
  match p:
    case Some{p}:p
    case None{}:C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,0.0}

def sub(a:C.Vec3,b:C.Vec3) -> C.Vec3:
  C.Vec3{x,y,z} = a
  C.Vec3{u,v,w} = b
  C.Vec3{F32.sub(x,u),F32.sub(y,v),F32.sub(z,w)}

def cross(a:C.Vec3,b:C.Vec3) -> C.Vec3:
  C.Vec3{+x,+y,+z} = a
  C.Vec3{+u,+v,+w} = b
  C.Vec3{(y * w - z * v : F32),(z * u - x * w : F32),(x * v - y * u : F32)}

# The reference surface normal comes from independently transformed tangents,
# not the production inverse transpose or matrix multiplication.
def normal(+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32) -> C.Vec3:
  +fuel = 1n+List.length(&2,HW.Row,rows)
  +origin = unpack(Check.walk(fuel,rows,index,C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,0.0}))
  x = sub(unpack(Check.walk(fuel,rows,index,C.Vec3{1.0,0.0,0.0})),origin)
  y = sub(unpack(Check.walk(fuel,rows,index,C.Vec3{0.0,1.0,0.0})),origin)
  cross(x,y)

def vertices(vs:List<&2,F.Vertex>,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32,+n:C.Vec3) -> List<&2,F.Vertex>:
  match vs:
    case []:[]
    case F.Vertex{p,c,uv,_} <> rest:F.Vertex{unpack(Check.walk(1n+List.length(&2,HW.Row,rows),rows,index,p)),c,uv,n} <> vertices(rest,rows,index,n)

def reference_mesh(mesh:F.Mesh,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32) -> F.Mesh:
  F.Mesh{vs,is1} = mesh
  F.Mesh{vertices(vs,rows,index,normal(rows,index)),is1}

def reference_instances(items:List<&2,Create.Instance>,+rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+index:U32) -> List<&2,Create.Instance>:
  match items:
    case []:[]
    case Create.Instance{m,c,_} <> rest:Create.Instance{reference_mesh(m,rows,index),c,C.Transform.identity()} <> reference_instances(rest,rows,U32.inc(index))
    case Create.Parented{m,c,_,_} <> rest:Create.Instance{reference_mesh(m,rows,index),c,C.Transform.identity()} <> reference_instances(rest,rows,U32.inc(index))

def reference(rows:List<&2,HW.Row>) -> Create.Scene:
  Create.Scene{items} = Scenes.showcase()
  Create.Scene{reference_instances(items,rows,0)}

def bytes_word(a:U32,b:U32,c:U32,d:U32) -> U32:
  U32.or(a,U32.or((b << 8n : U32),U32.or((c << 16n : U32),(d << 24n : U32))))

def depth_equal(a:List<&2,U32>,b:List<&2,U32>) -> Bool:
  match a b:
    case [],[]:True{}
    case a <> b <> c <> d <> xs,e <> f <> g <> h <> ys:F32.is_le(F32.abs(F32.sub(M.float_word(bytes_word(a,b,c,d)),M.float_word(bytes_word(e,f,g,h)))),0.000002) && depth_equal(xs,ys)
    case _ _:False{}

def colors_equal(a:List<&2,U32>,b:List<&2,U32>) -> Bool:
  match a b:
    case [],[]:True{}
    case x <> xs,y <> ys:Transform.close(x,y) && colors_equal(xs,ys)
    case _ _:False{}

def covered(depth:List<&2,U32>) -> U32:
  match depth:
    case []:0
    case a <> b <> c <> d <> rest:U32.add(Bool.to_u32(U32.is_ne(bytes_word(a,b,c,d),1065353216)),covered(rest))
    case _:0

def compare(a:R.Readback,b:R.Readback) -> V.Action(Unit):
  R.Readback{_,_,rgba,+depth} = a
  R.Readback{_,_,expected,expected_depth} = b
  Error.require(U32.is_gt(covered(depth),100) && colors_equal(rgba,expected) && depth_equal(depth,expected_depth),"Hierarchy affine rendering/lighting differs from independent baked geometry")

def reference_draws(seeds:List<&2,Create.Seed>) -> List<&2,Draw.DrawItem>:
  match seeds:

  match key:
    case 49:Some{1}
    case 50:Some{2}
    case 51:Some{3}
    case 52:Some{4}
    case 53:Some{5}
    case 54:Some{6}
    case 55:Some{7}
    case 56:Some{8}
    case 57:Some{9}
    case 114:Some{0}
    case 98:Some{12}
    case _:None{}

def applied(action:Maybe<&2,U32>,state:State) -> IO(State):
  match action state:
    case None{} state:IO.pure(State,state)
    case Some{code} State{app,rows}:
      do IO<State>:
        pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- Drive.step(code,(app,rows))
        return initial(pair)

def input(events:List<Event>,state:State) -> IO(Maybe<State>):
  match events:
    case []:IO.pure(Maybe<State>,Some{state})
    case Close{} <> _:IO.pure(Maybe<State>,None{})
    case Key{27,True{}} <> _:IO.pure(Maybe<State>,None{})
    case Key{key,True{}} <> rest:
      do IO<Maybe<State>>:
        state:State <- applied(code(key),state)
        input(rest,state)
    case _ <> rest:input(rest,state)

def frame(renderer:Win.Renderer,snapshot:V.WindowSnapshot,state:Maybe<State>) -> V.Action(Maybe<Running>):
  match state:
    case None{}:
      do V.Action<Maybe<Running>>:
        Win.close(renderer)
        return None{}
    case Some{State{app,+rows}}:
      do V.Action<Maybe<Running>>:
        pair:Win.Renderer & Result<&2,&2,Win.InputError,Unit> <- Win.frame(renderer,snapshot,_ => _ => Some{Pixel.camera()},Draw.DrawList{HW.draw_rows(rows)})
        renderer:Win.Renderer <- Error.owner(Win.Renderer,Win.InputError,Unit,pair,"Hierarchy window frame rejected")
        return Some{Running{renderer,State{app,rows}}}

def polled(pair:Win.Renderer & V.WindowSnapshot,state:State) -> V.Action(Maybe<Running>):
  (renderer,snapshot) = pair
  V.WindowSnapshot{w,h,mapped,focused,captured,events} = snapshot
  do V.Action<Maybe<Running>>:
    state:Maybe<State> <- V.Action.lift(Maybe<State>,input(events,state))
    frame(renderer,V.WindowSnapshot{w,h,mapped,focused,captured,[]},state)

def loop(fuel:Nat,running:Maybe<Running>) -> V.Action(Unit):
  match fuel running:
    case _ None{}:V.Action.pure(Unit,Unit{})
    case 0n Some{Running{renderer,_}}:Win.close(renderer)
    case 1n+n Some{Running{renderer,state}}:
      do V.Action<Unit>:
        pair:Win.Renderer & V.WindowSnapshot <- Win.poll(renderer)
        next:Maybe<Running> <- polled(pair,state)
        loop(n,next)

def run(entry:V.Entry,compiled:Create.Compiled) -> V.Action(Unit):
  Create.Compiled{_,geometry} = compiled
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,Drive.boot())
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,Drive.step(0,pair))
    renderer:Win.Renderer <- Win.open(entry,"Entangle scene hierarchy",geometry)
    loop(100000n,Some{Running{renderer,initial(pair)}})

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    compiled:Create.Compiled <- Consumer.compiled(Create.compile(Scenes.showcase()))
    pair:V.VkResult(Unit) & U32 <- Scope.with(Unit,entry => run(entry,compiled))
    Render.finished(pair)
    IO.print("Hierarchy window closed; live Vulkan objects: 0")
EOF

  Bool.pick(C.Vec3,U32.is_zero(mode),Bool.pick(C.Vec3,U32.is_zero(index),C.Vec3{root,0.125,0.0},position(mode,index)),C.Vec3{F32.add(root,F32.mul(level,0.25)),F32.mul(F32.add(level,1.0),0.125),0.0})

def verify(rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,+mode:U32,+count:U32,+index:U32,+root:F32) -> IO(Unit):
  match rows:
    case []:S.require(U32.is_eq(index,count),"Benchmark missing ECS rows")
    case HW.Row{_,_,_,H.Spatial{_,global,bounds}} <> rest:
      +p = expected(mode,count,index,root)
      do IO<Unit>:
        S.require(Check.vec(H.point(H.matrix(global),C.Vec3{0.0,0.0,0.0}),p),"Benchmark hierarchy state differs from analytic translation forest")
        S.require(Check.bounds(Some{H.transformed(H.corners(H.Bounds{C.Vec3{F32.neg(0.5),F32.neg(0.5),0.0},C.Vec3{0.5,0.5,0.0}}),M.model(C.Transform{p,Scenes.rotation(),Scenes.unit()}),H.Empty{})},bounds),"Benchmark world bounds differ")
        verify(rest,mode,count,U32.inc(index),root)

def time() -> IO(U.U64):
  do IO<U.U64>:
    result:V.VkResult(U.U64) <- V.monotonic_ns()
    V.or_exit(U.U64,result)

def milliseconds(value:U.U64) -> F32:
  U.U64{lo,hi} = value
  ((U32.to_f32(hi) * 4294967296.0 + U32.to_f32(lo)) / 1000000.0 : F32)

def mutation(app:Scene.Application(),root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+step:U32) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  Check.accepted(Scene.set_transform(app,root,Scenes.pose(Bool.pick(F32,U32.is_zero(U32.mod(step,2)),0.5,0.75),0.125,0.0,Scenes.rotation(),Scenes.unit())),True{})

def update_loop(fuel:Nat,+root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+step:U32,app:Scene.Application()) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  match fuel:
    case 0n:IO.pure(Scene.Application(),app)
    case 1n+n:
      do IO<Scene.Application()>:
        app:Scene.Application() <- mutation(app,root,step)
        update_loop(n,root,U32.inc(step),app)

def report(label:String,mode:U32,count:U32,steps:U32,elapsed:U.U64) -> IO(Unit):
  IO.print(label ++ " mode=" ++ U32.show(mode) ++ " nodes=" ++ U32.show(count) ++ " updates=" ++ U32.show(steps) ++ " errors=0 total_ms=" ++ F32.show(milliseconds(elapsed)))

def verified(app:Scene.Application(),mode:U32,count:U32,root:F32) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  do IO<Scene.Application()>:
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- Check.capture(app)
    verify_capture(pair,mode,count,root)

def verify_capture(pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,mode:U32,count:U32,root:F32) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  (app,rows) = pair
  do IO<Scene.Application()>:
    verify(rows,mode,count,0,root)
    return app

def cpu(app:Scene.Application(),+root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+mode:U32,+count:U32,+steps:U32) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  do IO<Scene.Application()>:
    app:Scene.Application() <- mutation(app,root,0)
    start:U.U64 <- time()
    app:Scene.Application() <- update_loop(U32.to_nat(steps),root,0,app)
    end:U.U64 <- time()
    app:Scene.Application() <- verified(app,mode,count,Bool.pick(F32,U32.is_zero(U32.mod(steps,2)),0.75,0.5))
    report("publication",mode,count,steps,U.add(end,U.neg(start)))
    return app

def camera(+mode:U32,+count:U32) -> M.Mat4:
  +span = Bool.pick(F32,U32.is_zero(mode),50.0,Bool.pick(F32,U32.is_eq(mode,1),F32.mul(U32.to_f32(count),0.3),4.0))
  +s = F32.div(1.8,span)
  M.Mat4{M.Vec4{s,0.0,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,s,0.0,0.0},M.Vec4{0.0,0.0,0.1,0.0},M.Vec4{F32.neg(0.8),F32.neg(0.8),0.5,1.0}}

def observed_frame(pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,renderer:R.Renderer) -> V.Action(Scene.Application() & R.Renderer):
  (app,rows) = pair
  do V.Action<Scene.Application() & R.Renderer>:
    pair:R.Renderer & R.Readback <- Existing.frame(renderer,Draw.DrawList{HW.draw_rows(rows)})
    return (app,Pair.fst(R.Renderer,R.Readback,pair))

def frame_loop(fuel:Nat,+root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,+step:U32,app:Scene.Application(),renderer:R.Renderer) -> V.Action(Scene.Application() & R.Renderer):
  match fuel:
    case 0n:V.Action.pure(Scene.Application() & R.Renderer,(app,renderer))
    case 1n+n:
      do V.Action<Scene.Application() & R.Renderer>:
        app:Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),mutation(app,root,step))
        observed:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,Check.capture(app))
        pair:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer <- observed_frame(observed,renderer)
        continue_frames(frame_loop(n,root,U32.inc(step)),pair)

def continue_frames(next:Scene.Application() -> R.Renderer -> V.Action(Scene.Application() & R.Renderer),pair:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer) -> V.Action(Scene.Application() & R.Renderer):
  (app,renderer) = pair
  next(app,renderer)

def rendered(pair:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer,+mode:U32,+count:U32,+steps:U32,start:U.U64) -> V.Action(Unit):
  (app,renderer) = pair
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    end:U.U64 <- V.Action.lift(U.U64,time())
    app:Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),verified(app,mode,count,Bool.pick(F32,U32.is_zero(U32.mod(steps,2)),0.75,0.5)))
    V.Action.lift(Unit,report("offscreen-frame",mode,count,steps,U.add(end,U.neg(start))))

def measured(entry:V.Entry,geometry:Create.Geometry,pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,+mode:U32,+count:U32,+steps:U32) -> V.Action(Unit):
  (app,rows) = pair
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    +root:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- V.Action.lift(W.Handle<D.Schema>,Check.entity(Check.at(rows,0n)))
    app:Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),cpu(app,root,mode,count,steps))
    renderer:R.Renderer <- R.create(entry,R.Config{256,256,camera(mode,count),Light.default()},geometry)
    warmed:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer <- frame_loop(1n,root,0,app,renderer)
    measure_frames(warmed,root,mode,count,steps)

def measure_frames(pair:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer,root:W.Handle<D.Schema>,mode:U32,count:U32,+steps:U32) -> V.Action(Unit):
  (app,renderer) = pair
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    start:U.U64 <- V.Action.lift(U.U64,time())
    pair:Scene.Application() & R.Renderer <- frame_loop(U32.to_nat(steps),root,0,app,renderer)
    rendered(pair,mode,count,steps,start)

def run(entry:V.Entry,compiled:Create.Compiled,mode:U32,count:U32,steps:U32) -> V.Action(Unit):
  Create.Compiled{seeds,geometry} = compiled
  do V.Action<Unit>:
    app:Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),Scene.create(seeds))
    app:Scene.Application() <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application(),Scene.tick(app))
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- V.Action.lift(Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>,Check.capture(app))
    measured(entry,geometry,pair,mode,count,steps)

def finished(pair:V.VkResult(Unit) & U32) -> IO(Unit):
  (result,count) = pair
  do IO<Unit>:
    V.or_exit(Unit,result)
    S.require(U32.is_zero(count),"Benchmark leaked Vulkan resources")

def arguments(args:List<String>) -> IO(Unit):
  match args:
    case [_,count,mode,steps]:numbers(U32.read(count),U32.read(mode),U32.read(steps))
    case _:IO.die(Unit,1,"Usage: hierarchy-benchmark count mode steps")

def numbers(count:Maybe<&2,U32>,mode:Maybe<&2,U32>,steps:Maybe<&2,U32>) -> IO(Unit):
  match count mode steps:
    case Some{+count} Some{+mode} Some{+steps}:
      do IO<Unit>:
        S.require(U32.is_gt(count,0) && U32.is_le(count,4096) && U32.is_le(mode,2) && U32.is_gt(steps,0),"Invalid benchmark workload")
        compiled:Create.Compiled <- Consumer.compiled(Create.compile(Create.Scene{instances(U32.to_nat(count),mode,0)}))
        pair:V.VkResult(Unit) & U32 <- Scope.with(Unit,entry => run(entry,compiled,mode,count,steps))
        finished(pair)
    case _ _ _:IO.die(Unit,1,"Invalid benchmark arguments")

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    args:List<String> <- IO.args
    arguments(args)
EOF

Validate the selected profile with real assets and explicit rejection paths; a compiler check alone does not choose a decoder [S41, S43].

Jonmath's `Matrix.multiply(left, right)` computes `right × left` in column-vector notation. Entangle's matrix function computes `left × right`. Preserve the existing Vulkan projection and choose a fixed numerical contract instead of switching simulation results according to the host's libm profile [S41].

The [native S41 qualification](docs/verification/2026-11-05-jonmath/README.md) confirms that operand reversal and explicit field conversion preserve the checked multiplication and quaternion/TRS words. text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > tools/hierarchy/profile.bend <<'EOF'
import Base
import ./benchmark.bend as B
import ./check.bend as Check
import ./scenes.bend as Scenes
import ../../src/scene.bend as Scene
import ../../src/scene-hierarchy.bend as HW
import ../../src/hierarchy.bend as H
import ../../src/scene-schema.bend as D
import ../../src/creation.bend as Create
import ../../deps/bendvy/src/ecs/world.bend as W
import ../../deps/bendvy/src/ecs/execution-schedule.bend as Scheduled
import ../../deps/bendvy/src/ecs/dependency-application.bend as App
import ../../deps/bend-vulkan/deps/bend-collections/src/math/u64.bend as U
import ../verify-creation.bend as Consumer

def report(label:String,start:U.U64,end:U.U64) -> IO(Unit):
  IO.print("profile " ++ label ++ " ms=" ++ F32.show(B.milliseconds(U.add(end,U.neg(start)))))

def committed(world:D.World(),start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  do IO<D.World()>:
    end:U.U64 <- B.time()
    report("commit",start,end)
    return world

def derived(world:D.World(),rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,result:Result<&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,H.Spatial>>,start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  match result:
    case Fail{_}:IO.die(D.World(),1,"Profile derivation rejected")
    case Done{values}:
      do IO<D.World()>:
        end:U.U64 <- B.time()
        report("derive",start,end)
        start:U.U64 <- B.time()
        committed(HW.commit(world,rows,values),start)

def read(result:D.World() & Result<&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,HW.Row>>,edit:HW.Edit,start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  match result:
    case (world,Fail{_}):IO.die(D.World(),1,"Profile read rejected")
    case (world,Done{+rows}):
      do IO<D.World()>:
        end:U.U64 <- B.time()
        report("read",start,end)
        start:U.U64 <- B.time()
        derived(world,rows,Result.bind(&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,H.Local>,List<&2,H.Spatial>,HW.candidate(edit,rows),xs => H.evaluate(xs)),start)

def profile(app:Scene.Application(),edit:HW.Edit) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred} = app
  do IO<Scene.Application()>:
    start:U.U64 <- B.time()
    world:D.World() <- read(HW.read(world),edit,start)
    return Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred}

def measured(pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(Unit):
  (app,rows) = pair
  do IO<Unit>:
    root:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(rows,0n))
    app:Scene.Application() <- profile(app,HW.SetTransform{root,Scenes.pose(0.5,0.125,0.0,Scenes.rotation(),Scenes.unit())})
    app:Scene.Application() <- B.verified(app,0,1000,0.5)
    return Unit{}

def start(compiled:Create.Compiled) -> IO(Unit):
  Create.Compiled{seeds,_} = compiled
  do IO<Unit>:
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.create(seeds)
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.tick(app)
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- Check.capture(app)
    measured(pair)

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    compiled:Create.Compiled <- Consumer.compiled(Create.compile(Create.Scene{B.instances(1000n,0,0)}))
    start(compiled)
EOF
bend tools/hierarchy/profile.bend -o build/hierarchy-profile > build/verification/hierarchy/profile-build.log 2>&1 && ./build/hierarchy-profile +RTS --threads 1 --gpu off > build/verification/hierarchy/profile.log 2>&1","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":500}));

import ../verify-creation.bend as Consumer

def report(label:String,start:U.U64,end:U.U64) -> IO(Unit):
  IO.print("profile " ++ label ++ " ms=" ++ F32.show(B.milliseconds(U.add(end,U.neg(start)))))

def committed(world:D.World(),start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  do IO<D.World()>:
    end:U.U64 <- B.time()
    report("commit",start,end)
    return world

def derived(world:D.World(),rows:List<&2,HW.Row>,result:Result<&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,H.Spatial>>,start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  match result:
    case Fail{_}:IO.die(D.World(),1,"Profile derivation rejected")
    case Done{values}:
      do IO<D.World()>:
        end:U.U64 <- B.time()
        report("derive",start,end)
        start:U.U64 <- B.time()
        committed(HW.commit(world,rows,values),start)

def read(result:D.World() & Result<&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,HW.Row>>,edit:HW.Edit,start:U.U64) -> IO(D.World()):
  match result:
    case (world,Fail{_}):IO.die(D.World(),1,"Profile read rejected")
    case (world,Done{+rows}):
      do IO<D.World()>:
        end:U.U64 <- B.time()
        report("read",start,end)
        start:U.U64 <- B.time()
        derived(world,rows,Result.bind(&2,&2,H.Error,List<&2,H.Local>,List<&2,H.Spatial>,HW.candidate(edit,rows),xs => H.evaluate(xs)),start)

def profile(app:Scene.Application(),edit:HW.Edit) -> IO(Scene.Application()):
  Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred} = app
  do IO<Scene.Application()>:
    start:U.U64 <- B.time()
    world:D.World() <- read(HW.read(world),edit,start)
    return Scheduled.Scheduled{App.State{world,nodes,guards,handler,stateBindings},settings,bindings,deferred}

def measured(pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row>) -> IO(Unit):
  (app,rows) = pair
  do IO<Unit>:
    root:W.Handle<D.Schema> <- Check.entity(Check.at(rows,0n))
    app:Scene.Application() <- profile(app,HW.SetTransform{root,Scenes.pose(0.5,0.125,0.0,Scenes.rotation(),Scenes.unit())})
    app:Scene.Application() <- B.verified(app,0,1000,0.5)
    return Unit{}

def start(compiled:Create.Compiled) -> IO(Unit):
  Create.Compiled{seeds,_} = compiled
  do IO<Unit>:
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.create(seeds)
    app:Scene.Application() <- Scene.tick(app)
    pair:Scene.Application() & List<&2,HW.Row> <- Check.capture(app)
    measured(pair)

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    compiled:Create.Compiled <- Consumer.compiled(Create.compile(Create.Scene{B.instances(1000n,0,0)}))
    start(compiled)
EOF

format.definition:
start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE

PRAGMA_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @exec:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/

tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.
